mapper.select: SELECT b.bi_idx, b.ui_idx, u.ui_name, b.bi_type, b.bi_title, b.bi_content, b.bi_category, b.bi_filename, b.bi_filepath, b.bi_refidx, CAST( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_recommend_info r WHERE r.bi_idx = b.bi_idx ) AS INTEGER ) AS recommend_count, b.time_created, b.time_modified FROM board_info b INNER JOIN user_info u ON b.ui_idx = u.ui_idx WHERE b.bi_idx = #{biIdx} AND b.bi_type = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_info ( ui_idx, bi_type, bi_title, bi_content, bi_category, bi_filename, bi_filepath, bi_refidx, time_created, time_modified ) VALUES ( #{uiIdx}, 1, #{biTitle}, #{biContent}, #{biCategory}, #{biFilename}, #{biFilepath}, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update:
UPDATE board_info
bi_title = #{biTitle}, bi_content = #{biContent},
bi_category = #{biCategory},
time_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE bi_idx = #{biIdx} AND ui_idx = #{uiIdx} AND bi_type = 1
UPDATE board_info SET bi_filename = #{biFilename}, bi_filepath = #{biFilepath}, time_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bi_idx = #{biIdx} AND ui_idx = #{uiIdx} AND bi_type = 1
